result.markdown:
The best HR software for a small company depends on whether you mainly need employee management, payroll, holiday tracking, recruitment, or a complete HR system.

**My recommendation: If you're a UK-based small business, I'd shortlist CharlieHR, Breathe HR, Employment Hero and HiBob.** They're more relevant to the UK market than US-focused platforms such as Gusto.

Here are my top choices for 2026.

## Best HR software for small businesses

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/bcGipSunA3wyOHFN4-sYhKm0_kGgwqJuW2QMJQ8KWPZObHMy7mNsqPvTyWN3_lHw6wOX9flFXDKPZQL1Wy1bGmTvj7N_0k78edMooellC315wygqyVhovrQhO0Zc9KmKs6CR5-YZ_7_FMFUIkuv_vpGDAORdCRAqxY48GXIgAdn4RvS3g9-8P23Rs8Y0gJA1?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. CharlieHR**

(Best overall for small UK businesses)

From approximately £21/month for 1–4 employees

- Employee records and documents
- Holiday and absence management
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Performance reviews
- HR reminders and workflows

Ideal for companies wanting straightforward HR without unnecessary complexity.

[CharlieHR website](https://www.charliehr.com/)

**2\. Breathe HR**

(Best for simplicity)

From approximately £24/month for 1–10 employees

- Staff records
- Holiday management
- Absence tracking

- Training records

Great for small companies that want to move away from spreadsheets.

**3\. Employment Hero**

(Best all-round functionality)

- HR and payroll functionality
- Employee self-service
- Recruitment and onboarding
- Performance management
- Automated HR workflows

Good if you want a broader platform that can support business growth.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

![SuiteApp.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/50J3sXexWPfsxKfwwXLZVE8WGU-FUGDFd8N4n9j1CT-0l82fXx9GT5B2oTOrwoRg8K_FLS7vFHzLGV7PyiGGaaG1FzAe1TZ8FdcaWXn0IMez90JBmenjZdXP40B4C4jvnSxIUzPlBb5OE_w7FVY9yXtQqtmfXSZ2xIxpQuzsEKl2MHZjGg0b08GlcpWer9bY?purpose=fullsize)

search_results.description: TechRadar’s 2026 guide evaluates leading HR software for payroll, compliance, recruitment, onboarding, benefits, performance management, and employee administration. Gusto is named best overall for its full-service payroll, time tracking, benefits administration, compliance support, and HR guidance. Employment Hero is recommended for small and medium-sized businesses because of its customizable workflows, automation, AI assistant, and broad feature set, though advanced functions and add-ons can increase costs. Rippling is best for versatility, particularly for distributed teams, offering remote device management, tax registration, scalable services, and per-employee billing. Other recommendations include Remote Payroll for international enterprises, BambooHR as an all-in-one system, Zoho People for integrations, Breathe HR for simple employee management, Deel for powerful global HR capabilities, PeopleHR for mobile access, Paylocity for mid-sized businesses, Staffology Payroll for complex enterprise payroll, Workable for recruitment, and BrightHR for extensive workforce-management features. The guide advises selecting software according to company size and specific workflow needs, and explains that testing considered usability, features, security, support, pricing, and user feedback.
